sora: Heads-up: onboarding smoke for vela-v2 shows detok boundary shifts when running int4 + kvcache on mixed CJK + RTL. Short repro below.

mike: Repro: `./run_eval --model vela-v2 --quant int4 --kvcache=on --samples samples/mixed_zh_he_ar.json`

mike: Raw sample: 这是（测试） then Hebrew: שלום(בדיקה) and Arabic: هذه(اختبار)

mike: fp16 detok: 这是（测试） ... שלום(בדיקה) ... هذه(اختبار)

mike: int4+kvcache detok: 这是）测试（ ... שלום)בדיקה( ... هذه)اختبار(  <-- parentheses reversed for all three scripts

yuna: I can repro on a V100. Only appears when kvcache replay + continuous batching enabled. Disabling kvcache fixes it.

omar: Token ids around boundary look identical between int4 and fp16, so this smells like cache-key alignment or tokenizer mismatch at runtime vs artifact. Model package lists tokenizer hash tz1, runtime has tz2.

ci-bot: CI: vela-v2/int4+kvcache smoke  BLEU -0.62 on mixed_zh_he_ar, 9 detok mismatches flagged.

sora: Plan: pin runtime tokenizer to tz1 and rerun canary; collect `--force-kernel` runs (fp16 vs int4) and a no-batching run to isolate ordering. Filing ML-4310 to track. @omar @yuna please help with bisect. :mag:
